theme: An open Saturday in St. Pete — one call due, Croatia three days out.
greeting: The calendar is clear today and the girls are with you in St. Pete. But one decision comes due before you fly Tuesday, and the Croatia checklist still has open p1s on it.

needsAttention.title: Halloween: St. Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: This call is due today and gates the Oct 18–Nov 1 Airbnb and car rental — both book while you're in Croatia. It's a decision better made from dry land than from the boat, so settle it before Tuesday.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the Nautilus boarding
needsAttention.detail: Reach the sailing instructor to lock the Sat Sept 12 boarding time and the Sept 19 return transfer. Charter connectivity is poor once aboard, so it has to be arranged from shore this week.

needsAttention.title: Open trip bookings before Sept 8
needsAttention.detail: Several p1 items are still past due against the hard Sept 8 departure: the one Cavtat night of Sept 19, the Sept 20–22 St. Pete landing gap, and written confirmation that checked bags are on the Eurowings ticket.

flagged.title: Amex added to Apple Pay
flagged.detail: American Express confirmed a card was added to Apple Pay — worth a glance to be sure it was you.

flagged.title: A caregiver applied on Care.com
flagged.detail: Carly M. applied to your posting and sent a message through Care.com.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and Labor Day promos — FT, Bloomberg, NYT Cooking, Kayak, market roundups.

resolved.title: UN PRI call with Conor is on hold
resolved.detail: Kate replied to close the loop — nothing owed now; she'll re-open the diary when you're back from the trip.

recipe.title: Chestnut and Pancetta Salad
recipe.why: An autumn dish that leans into the season's harvest and slower, warmer cooking.

tasks.title: Book refundable Sept 20–Oct 5 rental car as a hedge
Build and pack the travel larder bin
Buy EU plug adapters + a US power strip

acts.line: The day opens with nothing on the calendar — a rare fully clear Saturday.
A wide, unscheduled afternoon in St. Pete with the four girls, the last full weekend before you travel.
The only fixed point on the horizon is tomorrow's 9 AM Sunday review with Mike.
